mapper.sql: m.id, m.image_id, i.image_code, i.image_url, m.atlas_id, a.atlas_code, a.image_url AS atlas_image_url, a.species_id, s.herb_name AS species_name, m.similarity_score, m.match_rank, m.match_result, m.match_batch_no, m.match_time, m.create_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO herb_image_match ( image_id, atlas_id, similarity_score, match_rank, match_result, match_batch_no, match_time, create_time, update_time, deleted ) VALUES ( #{imageId}, #{atlasId}, #{similarityScore}, #{matchRank}, #{matchResult}, #{matchBatchNo}, #{matchTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{deleted} )

INSERT INTO herb_image_match ( image_id, atlas_id, similarity_score, match_rank, match_result, match_batch_no, match_time, create_time, update_time, deleted ) VALUES
( #{match.imageId}, #{match.atlasId}, #{match.similarityScore}, #{match.matchRank}, #{match.matchResult}, #{match.matchBatchNo}, #{match.matchTime}, #{match.createTime}, #{match.updateTime}, #{match.deleted} )
mapper.update: UPDATE herb_image_match SET deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE image_id = #{imageId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM herb_image_match WHERE image_id = #{imageId} AND deleted = 0

SELECT
FROM herb_image_match m INNER JOIN herb_image i ON i.id = m.image_id AND i.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN herb_atlas a ON a.id = m.atlas_id AND a.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN herb_species s ON s.id = a.species_id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE m.image_id = #{imageId} AND m.deleted = 0 AND m.match_batch_no = ( SELECT mm.match_batch_no FROM herb_image_match mm WHERE mm.image_id = #{imageId} AND mm.deleted = 0 AND mm.match_batch_no IS NOT NULL ORDER BY mm.match_time DESC, mm.create_time DESC LIMIT 1 ) ORDER BY m.match_rank ASC

FROM herb_image_match m INNER JOIN herb_image i ON i.id = m.image_id AND i.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN herb_atlas a ON a.id = m.atlas_id AND a.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN herb_species s ON s.id = a.species_id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE m.image_id = #{imageId} AND m.deleted = 0 ORDER BY m.match_time DESC, m.create_time DESC, m.match_rank ASC
